caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of fabric with a beige or light brown background and reddish-brown ink used for the design. The design features repeated large floral patterns with prominent roses and leaves scattered around the fabric, occupying much of the space. In the central section, there is an illustration of a merry-go-round labeled "TIVOLI DE LA UNION." The merry-go-round is a round structure with a roof, hanging boats for seating, and poles supporting the boats, with people sitting in some of the boats. On the left side of the central scene, a child stands on the ground facing the merry-go-round, while on the right side, two seated children are depicted, one holding what appears to be a doll. There is also a line of small, printed text at the bottom of the central scene, running horizontally. The overall composition consists of a combination of floral motifs and a central narrative scene, with the red and brown hues visually unifying the decorative and narrative elements.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
